description: This file declares the NeedMediaData class, which manages media data requests within the Rialto server component. It includes dependencies on media pipeline, shared memory, and request handling interfaces, and defines the class's constructor, destructor, and send method, along with private member variables.

classes.name: NeedMediaData
classes.description: A class responsible for handling media data requests, encapsulating the request parameters and state, and providing a method to send the request.

methods.name: NeedMediaData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NeedMediaData object with client, request, buffer, session, media source type, source ID, and playback state.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Method to send the media data request.
